Pharmacopoeias. In Br. BP 2008 (Hydrotalcite). A hydrated form of an aluminium mag- nesium basic carbonate corresponding to the formula Al2Mg6(OH)16CO3,4H2O. It contains not less than 15.3% and not more than 18.7% of Al2O3 and not less than 36.0% and not more than 44.0% of MgO. The ratio of Al2O3 to MgO is not less than 0.40 and not more than 0.45.
